summary: Implemented the context-bound SQLite/FTS5 projection adapter with versioned full rebuilds, atomic replacement, typed queries, strict isolation, documented semantics, and 41 projection tests; the complete 392-test repository gate passes.
behavior_implemented: Added projection metadata and a versioned schema for entities, aliases, tags, typed edges, derived backlinks, observations, claims, tasks, and external-content FTS5.

Added explicit and compatibility-triggered full rebuilds with deterministic canonical scanning, sanitized document-level skips, integrity checks, temporary build, reader gating, and atomic replacement.
Added frozen typed records and context-bound query APIs for exact resolution, aliases, traversal, observation provenance, claim history, task filters, metadata, and ranked literal search.
Added UTC timestamp normalization, nested JSON and locator round trips, percent-encoded observation ID handling, and unicode61-aligned query tokenization.
Added fail-closed context guards and containment checks for canonical zones, local references, configuration, state, database, temporary files, and SQLite sidecars.
Added 41 projection tests covering all rebuild triggers, equivalence, malformed and duplicate documents, context denial, backlinks, FTS, concurrency, schema damage, sidecars, and symlink/path races.

tests.result: Success: no issues found in 35 source files.
Exit code 0; no whitespace errors before the implementation commit.

assumptions: Projection schema version 1 is the first adapter schema and future incompatibilities rebuild fully under ADR 0007.
Canonical Markdown and YAML remain the sole source of truth; the projection never modifies canonical inputs.
Cross-process writer serialization is supplied by the later WP-200/WP-300 integration boundary.
Incremental freshness policy remains WP-300 scope; this delivery provides explicit and compatibility-triggered full rebuilds.
decisions: Use stdlib sqlite3 with DELETE journal mode for self-contained temporary builds and FTS5 unicode61 remove_diacritics 2 for full text.
Derive backlinks as a view over outbound edges so the two directions cannot drift.
Use short-lived private read-only connections and a process-local reader/swap gate; composite document lookup uses one connection snapshot.
Refuse unsafe, busy, orphaned, malformed, or symbolic-link SQLite sidecars instead of risking a new-main/stale-sidecar pairing.
Treat missing required tables, views, indexes, context guards, or FTS usability as an incompatible projection requiring full rebuild.
deviations: No implementation scope or path deviation.

The frozen contract still contains status proposed and base_commit PENDING-WAVE2-BASELINE; the direct assignment and existing Wave 2 head cf9ebabf10d565bb0eef0d8f686ebada3cdd34ab were used without editing frozen contract files.
security_considerations: All fixtures are fictional, and sanitized skip diagnostics never echo source content.
Context rows, structured references, queries, canonical zones, configuration, state, database, temporary files, and sidecars are constrained to the bound context and covered by denial tests.
Canonical inputs are parsed only through workctx.domain.frontmatter and the integrated domain models.
FTS5 absence and unsafe replacement conditions fail with typed errors while preserving the prior database or leaving no partial database.
migration_considerations: Projection or workspace schema mismatch triggers full canonical rebuild; projection tables are never migrated in place.
Deleting index.sqlite3 and rebuilding restores equivalent typed query results.
unresolved: Cross-process rebuild and canonical-write serialization remains for the filesystem/transaction integration; path revalidation and exact-identity cleanup bound, but cannot portably eliminate, every hostile concurrent rename interval.
Incremental projection freshness after canonical mutations remains WP-300 scope.
